module: Vehicle recovery system ("recover" key). While driving, records a history of positions/orientations every 0.2 s (up to 700 points, a point at least 2 m after the previous one). When recovery is held, the vehicle "rewinds" this path at increasing speed (3 -> 20 -> 50 m/s) with a recovery camera and a beam wireframe, then is teleported to the point reached on release. Also handles the "home" point (saveHome/loadHome) and multiplayer mode (server validation).
usage:
recovery.saveHome()        -- stores the current position as home
recovery.loadHome(false)    -- returns to it
recovery.recoverInPlace()   -- puts the vehicle upright in place
notes: Three modes of M.updateGFX: updateGFXRecord (recording, normal mode), updateGFXRecovery (rewind in progress), and nop (before init). init() installs updateGFXRecord.

Internal settings: recording interval 0.2 s, minimum separation 2 m, rewind speeds 3/20/50 m/s (ramps 2.5 s then 10 s), delay before visual teleport 0.5 s, history 700 points. A segment longer than 20 m (400 m²) cuts the rewind cleanly.

Without smart spawn: the orientation is straightened if pitch > 80° or roll > 45° (the heading direction is kept). With smart spawn (settings 'enableSmartRecovery', inverted by useAltMode) the teleport goes through spawn.safeTeleport on the GE side.
M.recoveryHooksOnly = true: start/stopRecovering only emit the GE hooks onStartRecovering / onStopRecovering(0) without touching the vehicle (used in the First Drive tutorial).

GE hooks emitted: onStartRecovering (start) and onStopRecovering(timer) (end, timer = real duration of the recovery in s). Also calls core_recoveryCamera.beginRecoveryCamera / endRecoveryCamera / setRecoveryCameraPosRot.

In multiplayer, startRecovering goes through multiplayer_vehicleSync.requestRecoveringBegin; the rest depends on onRecoveringBeginAllowed / onRecoveringBeginDenied, and the final point is validated by requestRecoveringCommit then applied by mpApplyRecoveryPoint.

Anomaly: M.recoveryPoints is a dequeue (not a simple array); onDeserialized rebuilds it via dequeue.new(v.recoveryPoints). M.homePoint is not declared at initialization (nil until the first saveHome or the first recording point).

Minor anomaly: in finishStopRecovering the non-MP path calls applyRecoveryPoint(lastRecoveryPoint, useSmartSpawn, nil, player): the player argument is passed in place of moveTraffic (4th parameter), the 3rd parameter player is nil.

recoveryPoints.desc: History of recovery points ({pos=vec3, dirFront=vec3, dirUp=vec3}), from oldest (left) to newest (right).

recoveryHooksOnly.desc: If true, the recovery input only emits the hooks without modifying the vehicle (First Drive tutorial). False by default.

homePoint.desc: "Home" point {pos, dirFront, dirUp} set by saveHome; nil as long as none is set (dynamically created field).

updateGFX.desc: nop at load, then replaced by updateGFXRecord (recording) or updateGFXRecovery (rewind). ⚠ nop reference not defined in the file (game global).

init.desc: Switches to recording mode, stores the number of beams and precomputes the relative positions of the nodes with respect to the reference node (to draw the wireframe).

clear.desc: Empties the point history, removes homePoint and invalidates the last recovery point.

onDeserialized.desc: Deserialization hook (vehicle Lua reload): merges the saved state into M and rebuilds the recoveryPoints queue.

saveHome.desc: Stores a home point. Without argument, uses the current position/orientation and displays the message 'vehicle.recovery.saveHome'.

point.desc: Point {pos, dirFront, dirUp}; current position if nil.

loadHome.desc: Requests the return to the home point (does nothing if there is none). Goes through multiplayer_vehicleSync.requestLoadHome if present, otherwise calls loadHomeLocal on the vehicle side.

moveTraffic.desc: Passed to spawn.safeTeleport: also move obstructing traffic.

loadHomeLocal.desc: Immediately teleports the vehicle to the home point and displays 'vehicle.recovery.loadHome'. Called by loadHome (or the MP server).

recoverInPlace.desc: Puts the vehicle upright at its current position (recovery point = current state, applied immediately).

startRecovering.desc: Starts the recovery (key press). In solo mode directly launches beginRecoveringPreview; in multiplayer first requests authorization from the server. Ignored if already in progress.

useAltMode.desc: Alternative mode: inverts the 'enableSmartRecovery' setting (false by default).

stopRecovering.desc: Requests the end of the recovery (key release); the actual stop and the teleport occur at the next updateGFX.

player.desc: Player that originated the request, passed to the teleport (inferred from code).

beginRecoveringPreview.desc: Actually enters rewind mode: creates a starting point, switches updateGFX to updateGFXRecovery, emits the GE hook onStartRecovering. Called by startRecovering or after MP authorization.

cancelRecoveringPreview.desc: Cancels the current recovery without teleporting: resumes recording, resets the materials and closes the recovery camera.

afterStopRecovering.desc: Finalizes a recovery: resets broken flexmesh beams, releases the nodes fixed by the grabber, displays the appropriate message, closes the camera and emits the GE hook onStopRecovering.

timer.desc: Recovery duration in seconds (default: measured duration).

mpApplyRecoveryPoint.desc: Applies a recovery point validated by the multiplayer server: teleports the vehicle (smart spawn or vehicleSetPositionRotation) then notifies multiplayer_vehicleSync.onVehicleRecoveryApplied.

action.desc: Action name sent back to the server.

onRecoveringBeginAllowed.desc: Hook called in multiplayer when the server allows the recovery: stores requestId and launches beginRecoveringPreview.

onRecoveringBeginDenied.desc: Hook called in multiplayer when the server denies the recovery: cancels the waiting state.
